title: Postcard template : picture box, message and address lines
subject: English
source: Written for english/y4 lesson 86 (Postcard template (pupil PDF, printable): picture box, message and address lines)
intro: Lesson 86: Writing a postcard from a US landmark. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

parts.text: Where and what: We're at the Golden Gate Bridge!
Detail with simile: Fog rolls under it like a soft grey blanket.
Feeling: I'm amazed; it's taller than I imagined.

panels.title: Picture side
points: Draw the landmark: a place, not people
Address side: name, street, town, postcode

keywords.def: a card with a picture and a short message
a comparison using like or as
verbs that show what is happening now
how we end: Lots of love, See you soon

questions.q: Write an opening sentence from your landmark
questions.a: For example: We're at the Grand Canyon!

questions.q: Core: write your postcard message: greeting, three sentences of detail, sign-off
Extend: include one fact from your research
Stretch: draw and caption the picture side
questions.a: A captioned picture of the landmark

questions.q: Which sentence is in the present tense?
options: The geyser shoots water into the sky.
The geyser shot water into the sky.
questions.a: B) The geyser shoots water into the sky.. shoots is present tense: it is happening now.
